stories.title: OPEN SECRETS: Digital Profiteers (Part One): A peek behind South Africa’s digitalised grants system
stories.snippet: In the past year, Open Secrets investigated the role of commercial banks in the administration of the Social Relief of Distress grant. Documents we have obtained reveal the banks are contracted by the Department of Social Development and the South African Social Security Agency to digitally verify grant beneficiaries’ income status and dispense grant payments from Sassa. stories.title: From deposit-takers to partners — how banks can rescue SA’s municipalities
stories.snippet: South African banks have long treated municipalities as transactional clients looking for deposit accounts, lending facilities and transaction fees. But as local government implodes under technical insolvency, revenue collapse and governance failure, this model is no longer tenable.
